text: I'm so sorry to message so late and I really hope I'm not wasting anyone's time, but I'm not sure what to do and my husband said to just ask. My son is 8 and he's had a temperature today, it's 38.4 now. About twenty minutes ago he had a sort of fit, which has never ever happened to him before. His arms and legs went stiff and then he was jerking and his eyes rolled back, it was over in maybe a minute or two but I've never seen anything like it and I'm still shaking. Since then he keeps saying his neck hurts and he won't look down, I asked him to touch his chin to his chest and he just can't or won't do it. He's also got a few spotty red bits on his tummy but I did the glass thing I've read about and they went pale when I pressed, so I think that part is ok? Sorry, I know this is a long message, I just wanted to give you everything. Thank you for reading it.
